arts.ttl: Why Bayern Munich will beat Arsenal in the UEFA Champions League
arts.sum: Unbeaten this season, boasting a favourable record against Arsenal and with North London specialist Harry Kane leading the charge, Bayern Munich will be quietly confident of chalking up another UEFA Champions League win on Wednesday. That streak includes a 16-game winning run - a European record - and Champions League victories against Chelsea, Pafos, Club Brugge and holders Paris Saint-Germain .
